name: UIB Capital
tagline: A personal portfolio, run in public.
intro: Every position, every thesis, every result — shown as percentages and updated automatically from the broker. Public stocks, crypto and early-stage investments.
about: UIB Capital is my personal investment portfolio. I publish what I own, why I own it, and how it has done — the good and the bad.

The approach is long-term: spot positions only, no leverage, no options and no shorting. Every new stock position gets a written thesis, and every exit gets a short note on what happened against that thesis.

The portfolio is measured as 80% stocks and 20% crypto (Ethereum and Solana). Stock figures come straight from Interactive Brokers and update every evening after the US market closes; crypto is valued daily from market prices. Amounts are never shown — only percentages.
Long-term holdings kept elsewhere, such as passive index funds and stablecoin cash reserves, are not part of this portfolio.
disclaimer: UIB Capital is a personal portfolio. Nothing on this site is investment advice, a recommendation, or an offer to manage money. Figures are percentages derived from broker data; past results do not predict future ones.
